summary: Operator site + ResNexus engine read: 61 RV sites, full hookups 20/30/50A on 46-61 ($30 weeknight, $40 weekend), W/E sites 26-27 $25; 3% card surcharge; book online a year ahead. Gate: $25-40, Google 4.6/952, RV Life $$. Only 18 of 61 sites are in the nightly engine (long-stay report). Nightly loop ~500 m from the lake (not waterfront stands; the west-point loop is closer, behind trees). Pin ~350-400 m off. Phone missing: 785-463-4000.

PIN MOVE: stored 39.153,-96.895 sits on the entrance road by the stormwater pond south of the resort; move to the office/store ~39.1561,-96.8973 (Google 39.156297,-96.898319), ~350-400 m.

GATE FACTS (private): posted rates $25 (W/E sites 26-27) and $30 weeknight / $40 weekend (full-hookup 46-61) from the operator's ResNexus engine, 2026-11-05; plus a 3% credit-card surcharge. Not a Good Sam Park (stored false). Presence: operator website with phone; Google 4.6 stars, 952 reviews (hotel-style panel); RV Life 4.5 stars, $$, 27 reviews (9.28). Under $50.

LONG-STAY (report; Google 4.6 keeps it off the automatic drop): of 61 RV sites only 18 (26, 27, 46-61) are in the nightly engine, and the engine says sites 46-61 'are for shorter term c[ampers]' - the other ~43 sites (the west-point and NE areas, by imagery) are not sold by the night online and are probably seasonal/long-term; the site also offers 'Long-term discounted stays'. Nightly stays are sold online, so test 2 passes, but the park is mostly non-nightly by site count.

WATERFRONT (not waterfront kept; operator claim 'We're right on the water!' re-audited): the nightly loop (46-61, by its 'near the trees' description) is ~450-550 m from the lake among trees. The west-point RV loop is ~50-80 m from the north shore behind a tree belt and a road, with an open grass slope to the water off its west edge - at best a lakeview for that area, and it does not appear to be sold by the night. Unsure, so no upgrade.
The weekend query showed 'ENJOY FOR 2 NIGHTS OR MORE' on every site; it may be a weekend 2-night minimum or just the 2-night default search - not written.
